name: garmidian
description: Garmin dashboard builder for Obsidian: paste a Personal API key, pick sports and metrics, insert a ready Dashy dashboard.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=main.js --platform=browser --format=cjs --target=es2020 --external:obsidian --external:electron --footer:js="module.exports = module.exports.default || module.exports;" && node scripts/assert-bundle.cjs
scripts.release:check: node scripts/version-sync.cjs && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
